results.title: Correction keys authored in the inspector (forearm_R +2 → +10 over 1.0–2.0 s) with smooth easing from the ease menu
The baked source track is byte-identical after authoring corrections (corrections are a separate layer)
Corrected pose differs from the bake inside the keyed range
Disable button restores the bake exactly; undo re-enables the same corrected pose
Saved ZIP reopened in a fresh page: same corrected pose, bake still unchanged, valid
Standalone runtime (exported package only) shows the same corrected pose as the editor
Runtime canvas (atlas pages) vs editor render, same pose and background: mean / >24-level pixel share (≥20% of the frame is character pixels)
Sprite-sheet frame vs editor render: alpha and premultiplication-safe RGB (opaque pixels); transparent background
Seeking to a time gives the identical pose and identical editor pixels regardless of prior playback/seeks
12 rapid 3D/2D + setup/animate switches: one 2D render loop, 2D mode active, no page errors
"Fit view" button re-frames the character (unique element id)
No hand appearance (set or keyed palm art) is shown for fewer than 4 frames in hero/regression clips
Every hand-set palm has art at the wrist joint (≤6 px), so set swaps never open a cuff gap
No page errors in editor, fresh page or runtime
